overview: This 517-page file traces U.S. and British oil companies’ negotiations with Japan over mandatory petroleum stocks, sales quotas, tariffs, and distribution controls from 1935 to 1939. Diplomatic and company records also document Japan’s synthetic fuel plans, dependence on imported oil, and pursuit of overseas supplies.
interest: Company cables and embassy records reveal how oil regulation, diplomatic pressure, and fuel security shaped foreign firms’ prospects in Japan.
